both-realtime.title: Two language apps in one afternoon
both-realtime.subtitle: Every minute of both apps at real speed, with only silences sped up; other work is a time-lapse
both-realtime.description: How this was edited: everything is in the order it happened. The clock on the right shows the real time, and sped-up parts show their speed. I cut a snack break and a chat with my house cleaner, and blurred screens with other people's information or my billing details.
